title: Count records with an ordered map
prompt: Return the number of times each input word appears. Use std::map so keys are ordered lexicographically when the caller iterates the result. Empty input gives an empty map. Case is significant.

tests.label: Empty
tests.hint: There are no counts to insert.

hints: operator[] creates a zero count for a missing key.
++ then increases either the new zero or a prior count.
explanation: A map stores key/value pairs and owns the strings. Its ordered iteration is useful for stable reports; an unordered_map may be faster when output order is irrelevant.
